up: Return the exact activity values, activity metadata (standard relation, units, assay type, target CHEMBL ID, organism), and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4513220. Include all activity rows, even if standard_value or relation are null. Do not deduplicate.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_type,
  ass.assay_type,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  ass.assay_organism,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
LEFT JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513220';
